mapper.select: SELECT permission.id, permission.code, permission.name FROM sys_role_permission role_permission INNER JOIN sys_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE role_permission.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id, create_by) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_account.id) FROM sys_user_role user_role INNER JOIN sys_user user_account ON user_account.id = user_role.user_id WHERE user_role.role_id = #{roleId} AND user_account.status = 1
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY user_id
